newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA - ROKISHKIS 6-MO SALES ROSE TO 69 MLN LITAS.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA - ROKISHKIS 6-MO SALES ROSE TO 69 MLN LITAS.

text.p: Lithuania's Rokishkis Cheese said on Monday that its sales rose to 69 million litas in the first half of the year from 38.4 million litas in the same period in 1996.
The company's financial analyst Valerija Shimeniene also told Reuters that the sales of Rokishkis Cheese in June were 12.9 million litas.
The company reported earlier that its sales in the first five months of the year were 55.8 million litas.
"Last month our sales were high mainly because of exported production to Russia and Holland," Shimeniene said.
"In June the company exported around 72 percent of its products," Shimeniene added.
She also said that the profit figures for the first-half of 1997 were expected on July 15.
Rokishkis Cheese said its net profit for the first five months of the year was 7.15 million litas.
The company is one of the blue chips traded on Vilnius bourse.
